blinding_guess.why: At this revision the three elements are mutually consistent inside the package: HEARTBEAT.custom_mode is written as control_mode (the FlightMode value), and the SET_MODE handler accepts every FlightMode value except INITIALISING, including the QuadPlane modes 17-21. The only latent issue seen is that SET_MODE.custom_mode is narrowed to uint8_t by set_mode_fn, which does not affect the defined mode numbers.

notes: Snapshot is the full ardupilot tree; ArduPlane builds against libraries/GCS_MAVLink, so library code is cited where ArduPlane's own handlers delegate to it. FlightMode enumerators at this revision (defines.h:50-70): MANUAL=0, CIRCLE=1, STABILIZE=2, TRAINING=3, ACRO=4, FLY_BY_WIRE_A=5, FLY_BY_WIRE_B=6, CRUISE=7, AUTOTUNE=8, AUTO=10, RTL=11, LOITER=12, GUIDED=15, INITIALISING=16, QSTABILIZE=17, QHOVER=18, QLOITER=19, QLAND=20, QRTL=21 (9, 13, 14 unused). The MAVLink message definitions are not in the snapshot: modules/mavlink (git submodule) is empty and the generated include/mavlink/v2.0 headers referenced by libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS_MAVLink.h:27,31,92 are absent; MAVLink definitions are XML (not an allowed .msg/.srv/.action/.idl kind) and ros_distro is null, so no definition was fetched and all definition_id values are null. The declared type of HEARTBEAT.custom_mode (uint32_t) therefore comes from the package's send path, not from the definition text. SET_MODE handling: GCS_Common.cpp:1424 requires base_mode & MAV_MODE_FLAG_CUSTOM_MODE_ENABLED, then passes packet.custom_mode through set_mode_fn, typedef'd FUNCTOR_TYPEDEF(set_mode_fn, bool, uint8_t) at GCS.h:236, into Plane::mavlink_set_mode(uint8_t mode) (system.cpp:490), a whitelist switch over all FlightMode values except INITIALISING that returns false otherwise; the value is narrowed to 8 bits before the whitelist. Result is acknowledged with COMMAND_ACK (GCS_Common.cpp:1443). SET_MODE is not filtered by SYSID_MYGCS (that check exists only for RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE and HEARTBEAT, GCS_Mavlink.cpp:1905,1934). MAV_CMD_DO_SET_MODE (GCS_Mavlink.cpp:1462-1484) maps only MAV_MODE_* base modes to MANUAL/AUTO/FLY_BY_WIRE_A and does not use custom_mode. Heartbeat base_mode is derived per FlightMode at GCS_Mavlink.cpp:35-67 with a case for every enumerator. perm_requires records the MAVLink2 signing gate, which is runtime-conditional on a stored signing key (set via SETUP_SIGNING, GCS_Mavlink.cpp:2170-2171) and applies to all incoming messages, not only SET_MODE. Parameter documentation @Values for FLTMODE1-6 and INITIAL_MODE (Parameters.cpp:685-728) list modes 0-15 only and omit 17-21; read_control_switch casts the FLTMODEn value to FlightMode without validation (control_modes.cpp:44). Other recovery paths tied to these elements: set_mode reverts control_mode to previous_mode if quadplane.init_mode() fails for Q modes (system.cpp). manifest_version is taken from ArduPlane/version.h because ArduPlane has no ROS package manifest. exclusive is empty: no exclusive claim is attached to these elements; firmware-wide hardware ownership (RC outputs, serial ports) was not inventoried. QoS is null throughout (ROS1-generation packet; MAVLink over serial has no QoS API).
